findings.summary: The badpath check uses a plain string-prefix test, so sibling directories like /tmp/out_evil pass for base /tmp/out and members can be written outside the target directory (path traversal); the same flaw is copied into the zip, rar and 7z extractors (lines 261, 337) and the existing tar extractor (line 108).

In the 7z extractor, if all members are blocked, targets is an empty list, and py7zr may treat it like None and extract everything, bypassing the filter; this needs verification against the pinned py7zr version.
Blocked 7z members are only logged with logger.error, so extraction still reports success (probably intentional, matching tar behaviour).
badlink is defined but never called in SevenZipExtractor.safemembers because the call is commented out.
TarExtractor.safemembers annotates members as tarfile.TarFile, but it is actually an iterable of TarInfo.
